Chapter 6916: Karma Slash

Chapter 6916: Karma Slash

The infusion of the dark high heaven twisted all affinities. No other powers were allowed to exist in Stygian.

The darkness in the form of the high heaven became the source of everything. Thus, it served as the highest truth and law.

“Karma Slash!” The immortal had also twisted karma. Sins of the past have been forgiven. On the other hand, the light and anything related to the dao heart became sins.

Therefore, the cultivation of the dao heart became depravity. This appeared rather effective against Li Qiye, the potential greatest sinner.

Spectators outside Stygian were horrified after seeing the giant’s reflection on the barriers. Just looking at the reflection alone made them want to fall into the darkness.

The slash began affecting the outside worlds, shifting the karmic balance. Immortals were horrified to see themselves on the wrong side of karma.

Fortunately, this was only a reflection in the barriers and didn’t have a tangible effect. Nevertheless, it did shock spectators momentarily. They immediately guarded their dao heart to stop any potential shift.

“A dark high heaven?” An immortal said.

If such a being were to descend, no one could escape from the effect.

“No, it has to be a sacrificial ceremony from Devouring Alliance, it is twisting the high heaven’s will.” A primordial immortal speculated.

Meanwhile, the slash struck Li Qiye. Since his dao heart was the toughest, so was his fall into depravity under the new system.

“Judge me with this so-called high heaven power? Can you endure my fall to depravity?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Die!” The giant continued, delivering death to the sinner.

“Fine, cut it down.” Li Qiye released his dao heart power.

“Rumble!” The primeval realm immediately collapsed, unable to bear the weight of Li Qiye’s sin. This was more than the dark high heaven could handle. His depravity easily overwhelmed the judgment.

“Bam!” The reversed karma and the other affinities also collapsed.

“Impossible!” His dao heart crushed the giant, forcing it down to the ground.

This scared the hell out of Guangmai. Earlier, he was more astounded than anything since he had confidence in this dark form. He believed that the judgment could grievously injure celestial immortals.

Now, the result horrified him. From another angle, this mortal had just crushed the high heaven. He realized the mortal must be greater than a celestial immortal.

“What are you?! A true immortal, no, impossible!” He shouted.

“Who can say for sure?” Li Qiye smiled: “But I am certain about one thing, you are not the high heaven, not even a dark version, only a twisted form.”

“Go!” Guangmai released all of his dark light and tribulations.

“This is useless, but I’ll borrow the villainous heaven’s tribulations.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Not like this!” Guangmai still didn’t accept failure. The pressure from Li Qiye’s depravity pulverized his flesh into paste.
